content_units: Kyoto 5-Day Weather Snapshot
Kyoto looks mixed across these 5 days: two excellent dry days, one decent but slightly uncertain day, and two clearly wet days.
The standout day for walking temples is   2026-04-13  , while the toughest day for outdoor plans is   2026-04-12  .
Kyoto Day-by-Day Forecast
Day   Condition   Temp   Rain Chance   Wind   Humidity   UV   What to wear
Apr 10   Partly cloudy   10–19°C   20%   Light   Moderate   Moderate   Light layers; comfortable walking shoes
Apr 11   Showers   12–22°C   70%   Light to moderate   Higher   Low-Moderate   Light rain jacket; umbrella
Apr 12   Steady rain   9–17°C   80%   Light   High   Low   Waterproof jacket; umbrella; water-resistant shoes
Apr 13   Sunny   11–20°C   10%   Light   Comfortable   Moderate   Light layers; ideal for long walks
Apr 14   Warm and clear   14–24°C   30%   Light   Mild   Moderate-High   Breathable clothing; light layer for morning/evening
Temple Walk Pick and Outdoor Risk
Best day for a temple walk: 2026-04-13 (Sunny, 20°C, 10% rain chance)
- Best balance of   dry weather  ,   pleasant temperature  , and   comfortable walking conditions  .
- Better than Apr 14 for long temple walks because it is slightly cooler and has a lower rain risk.
Worst day for outdoor plans: 2026-04-12 (Steady rain, 17°C, 80% rain chance)
- Highest likelihood of persistent rain.
- Poor fit for gardens, temple grounds, scenic walks, and long outdoor sightseeing.
Trip-Planning Notes
Context used: forecast dates are interpreted in   JST   exactly as provided.
-   Best backup day:     2026-04-14   if you want warmer weather and mostly favorable conditions.
-   Most flexible day:     2026-04-10   is still quite usable for outdoor time with only a small rain risk.
-   Indoor-friendly days:     2026-04-11   and   2026-04-12   are better for museums, tea houses, covered markets, or shorter temple visits.
